title: Startup Investment Instruments: Liquidation Preference and Vesting

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The Hungarian startup ecosystem relies on venture capital funding (*kockázati tőkebevonás*). Negotiations start with a non-binding *term sheet* outlining the core economic and governance parameters.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Key protection mechanisms include *likvidációs preferencia* (investors get paid first in an exit) and *hígulásvédelem* (protecting equity percentage in down-rounds), formalized in a binding *szindikátusi szerződés* (shareholders' agreement).
